_comment: Per-provider image upload limits (long edge in pixels, max bytes). Neither models.dev nor LiteLLM carries these; they are a vendor's upload limit, not a model fact. The job joins a provider's row onto every model of that provider. Keys are models.dev canonical provider ids. Seeded 2026-08-23 from Omnipus pkg/providers/capabilities/data/providers_capabilities_seed.json (version 2026-07-28), which used exactly four distinct values across 78 models; providers in that seed that carried no resize_budget (deepseek, and some minimax/moonshot/z-ai rows) fall to default. Old seed ids mapped to canonical ids: z-ai -> zai, moonshot -> moonshotai. Unverified against vendor docs beyond the seed's own 2026-07-28 re-validation; correct by pull request with a documentation link. max_patches (optional, added 2026-11-07, omnipus#1435): the most 32x32-pixel patches an image may need, ceil(w/32)*ceil(h/32) per OpenAI's image guide; 30000 is the ChatGPT ceiling from omnipus#1435. It is set on the default and on openai-chatgpt, the two rows the Omnipus embedded catalog carried by hand since omnipus ba6bbdcb2.
